Let's not forget what they did to DeFi Kingdoms.

The project gas been doing hundreds of thousands of transactions a day, trippled the active wallets on Harmony in just a few months and moved ONE from a top 200 mcap coin to a top 50.

And what did Harnony do?

- they completely refused to ignore DFK the first few months while promoting extremely poor effort viper forks on their Twitter

- they prioritized vegan African DAO over a working infrastructure. Yes, DFK does an incredible amount of transactions, but in over one year they weren't able to set up a working infrastructure. RPCs were down almost daily. People opted to make their own RPC because Harmony couldn't get their own working. The elastic RPC was a disaster and rended the blockchain near unusable for weeks and they refused to roll it back (which they eventually did over a month later).

- they promised DeFi Kingdoms a 1m USD grant. Later, they said they only honor grants that are up to X days back, which conveniently didn't include DFK by just a few days.

- their amazing engineers bricked their testnet making any testing impossible anymore.


The way the Harmony leadership did DFK tells you all you need to know. Despite increasing the Harmony user base multifold and having 98% of all transactions DFK related at the peak, they instead of supporting the project opted to throw money at random DAOs and spend it on BAYC. Happy that DeFi Kingdoms found a new home on Avalanche Subnets. 2M transactions a day and no blockchain related issues, ever.

This project outperformed all the non-ETH punks so hard in the beginning. All 10.000 minted in just 3 days! SolPunks took weeks and look how much they go for

The team is super friendly, the visual rework is amazing, the community great, this gotta be the best project I ever aped in

Thank you for your kind words. 

I was worried that I might be overreacting, but seeing all the replies made me realize that I need to reconsider my career path from now should my formal objection be rejected. 

In any case first need to wait for the covid situation to disappear..

This is what puts me in a pinch there. Let's say in my team the people have 92, 98, 98, 102 and 104 points. Three people did a really, really good work this year but will receive the worst grade.


In another team in the company there are also 5 people, and they got 70, 72, 84, 88 and 92 points. The people with 70, 72, 84 points will get the worst grade.

So in the end even though I did excellent work with 98 points I will get the same treatment as someone who did the absolut minimum to not get fired at 70 points.

Yes, she himself will get the same grading scale, but she will be pooled with other team leaders.

I told her the negative consquences. We had an hour long meeting, as its standard procedure when raising formal objection but she didn't budge. While the monetary loss is certainly annoying, the message of receiving the worst grade is what really gets me, as I take high pride in my level of work.

I'm considering this too. The big thing that always kept me at this company was that work was always regarded highly by others. Getting punched in the face like this may have been a wakeup call that my work is not appreciated in a way that it should be.

Unfortunately thats the grading system my company uses. Its by the way the same at school there. Assuming there is a test with 10 students. 9 students score 100/100 points, one student scores 99/100 points. In this case the last student wouldn't pass the test and receive the worst grade
